productConcept.name: Margin
productConcept.description: A structured annotation and specification tool for technical writers, standards authors, and documentation teams who need to mark the record with surgical exactness.
productConcept.rationale: The Quartz Ledger design system's Inter-dominant palette with 0.06em tracked headings, monospace accents (JetBrains Mono), and achromatic white-black-yellow color register signalled a precision productivity tool rather than a luxury or editorial brand. The yellow #ffdb01 as the single chromatic assertion fits a SaaS conversion vector — visible from any scroll position. The compressed 29.376px gutters and masonry grid patterns from concept_by_image.md align with structured document layout. Annotation tooling emerged as a distinct niche: not a generic productivity app (overused), not a writing tool (too broad), but a compliance-grade annotation layer — traceable, versioned, standards-mapped.
